== Published English Original Virtual Set 1 wording ==
The early slips print a once-per-deploy-phase limit. The 2006 text keeps a just-deployed unique character trigger during your deploy phase and removes the explicit once-per-phase limit. The matching weapon, destination, Reserve Deck, reshuffle and Alter immunity clauses remain. The January 2003, August 2003 and February 2004 Players Committee supplements explain the early text as a one-weapon-per-turn limit for each copy in play. They interpret the earlier text, without publishing a replacement card. The July 2007 One Rule separately limits a singular action to once in its specified phase. The changed printed phrase alone does not establish an extra deployment.
